## Outer loop: widget behaviors

UI acceptance scenarios (bug #830): asserted through a testWidgets pair — a view-builder subject stub plus a widget test that pumps the view and asserts the scenario.

The `kind` cell is the finder-kind taxonomy (issue #1140): the scenario verbs' predicted assertion classes — presence, absence, route-outcome, enabled-state, sequence — or `none` when no finder is derivable. `zfa tdd gen` selects the assertion template by it and refuses a row whose kind column drifted from the scenario prose; verify-red's kind gate (issue #959/#964) certifies on the same vocabulary.

## Inner loop: unit behaviors

One per functional requirement in `spec.md`.

| id | behavior | traces | state |
| -- | -------- | ------ | ----- |

| U2 | Sub-agent instances MUST persist and be resumable across engine restarts. | FR-002, subagentsAndDeclarative.fr2 | PENDING |
| U3 | Agent definitions MUST be expressible as declarative YAML specs with `extends` inheritance and validation diagnostics. | FR-003, subagentsAndDeclarative.fr3 | PENDING |

| U5 | Context isolation MUST guarantee parent receives result summaries only. | FR-005, subagentsAndDeclarative.fr5 | PENDING |
